description.value: Cheeky Monkey Glassworks is a glass art gallery and studio in Nanaimo operated by artist Brenda McIntyre, who has been creating custom glass art for over 25 years. The shop features original stained, fused, sandblasted, and mosaic glass pieces all made in-house, and also offers hands-on workshops and a well-stocked glass art supply section. Located on Terminal Avenue, it occupies a bright, welcoming studio space that Brenda describes as having a fun, cheeky atmosphere.
